$comment: Single source of truth for brand + wiring. baseUrl must equal the live Pages URL; verified with `gh api repos/sassnarep3-star/WinA/pages` after enabling, see COORDINATION.md T-17.

brand.name: The Preheat
brand.tagline: Buying guides for small appliances, built on the listing, the manual, and the public record — never on a hype cycle.
brand.descriptor: An independent, reader-supported buying guide for air fryers, multi-cookers and the counter space around them.
brand.bylineNote: Drafted with AI assistance, edited by the desk. No product was tested for this guide — and no human credential is implied by the byline.

marketplace.label: Amazon.com (United States)
marketplace.note: ASINs are marketplace-specific, so the marketplace has to be confirmed before any link is built. The -20 suffix on a US Store ID is the only evidence here, and it is recorded as an assumption, not a finding.

affiliate.trackingIdFormat: valid for a US Store/Tracking ID shape (ends -20, 15 chars, [a-z0-9-])
affiliate.linksDisabledReason: No submitted identifier resolved to a real listing yet, so there is nothing to link to. When a listing is confirmed, this card gains a price, a rating and a working button.
affiliate.statement: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

editorial.testingNote: No hands-on testing. Nothing on this site says a product was used, measured, or compared side by side, because none was.
editorial.sourcingRule: Every factual row cites an official source or stays blank; see /verify/.

measurement.provider: self-hosted endpoint (reference implementation in tools/analytics-server.mjs) + Amazon Associates Central reports for anything money-related
measurement.hostConstraint: GitHub Pages serves static files only; the endpoint needs somewhere that runs code (Q-09).
measurement.endpointNote: Empty on purpose: with no host chosen (Q-09) the site counts nothing, and app.js refuses to send when this is blank.
